build_gcn_layer: build a GCN layer with specified input/output dimensions, dropout, activation, and normalization
create_respool_aggregator: create a ResPool module with center/sort/max/mean pooling and residue concatenation for graph classification
build_gat_attention: build a multi-head GAT layer with custom attention coefficients and numerically stable softmax aggregation
create_ensemble_aggregator: create an EnsembleAggregator that combines multiple branch embeddings with learnable attention weights
build_graphsage_layer: build a GraphSAGE layer with separate self and neighbor linear transformations and feature normalization
